annotations.title: Today's brief and the one fix

description: Start here for "what should I do today?" or "what's wrong with my Meta ads?". Returns today's brief: the one fix to do first, other findings ranked by buyers lost (each with its item_key, the number behind it and exact steps), what changed, what is working and the live check status. It summarises the other tools; use get_performance for full numbers, get_live_alerts for every alert, get_sales_funnel for each funnel step. Also returns the Today screen: needs_you_now (critical live alerts, shown first), the headline (for example "3 fixes could lift your ROAS from 1.9x to about 2.6x", all estimates) and up to 3 fixes with problem, fix and worth. Pass an item_key to add_to_fix_list or send_paused_draft. Saved data from the latest hourly check.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.
